title: Influence of facial hair (clean-shaven, stubble, or beard) on the accuracy of 3-dimensional patient representation across four facial scanners: A clinical study
html: Facial scans, when combined with intraoral scans, enable the creation of 3-dimensional virtual patient models that support comprehensive dentofacial analysis. However, the increasing prevalence of facial hair among patients may interfere with image acquisition and stitching processes. The extent to which facial hair affects the accuracy of virtual patient representation remains unclear.
